structured_output.what_is_happening: A sand-cat (Felis margarita) kitten meme is part of a real cat-related buzz on X. This token is one of more than 10 Felis/SANDCAT copies launched within about 25 minutes of each other. It is not a pump.fun bonding-curve coin: the address has no 'pump' suffix, migrated_unix is 0, and it was created at 13:04:39 with a PumpSwap pool 50 seconds later. The deployer seems to have put liquidity in directly, which is why liquidity ($248k) is larger than market cap ($168k). RugCheck says that LP is unlocked and held by only a few providers. The coin has done $4.9M of volume in 38 minutes, turning its market cap over about 19 times. GeckoTerminal counts 2,088 unique buyers but only 54 unique sellers for 3,163 sells. GMGN tags 49 bundler wallets holding about 20% of trader share. Together this looks like manufactured volume with a creator who can pull the LP at any time, not organic demand.

narrative.description: A sand cat kitten 'going viral for looking AI generated but it's real'. There was cat-focused virality on X in mid-September 2026, and a sand cat kitten at The Living Desert zoo made local news. I could not find the specific viral post in search.
narrative.why_spreading: Cute-animal memes that look fake but are real spread easily on X, and the story is plausible. I could not confirm how big or how current the specific viral post is.

token_connection.why_this_token: Its only claim is having the most volume and liquidity among the copies, and it links to an X community. The deployer has no history, no website and no DexScreener profile.
token_connection.competing_tokens: There are at least 10 same-name tokens. They include pump.fun-native J4yq...pump (Felis, $52k market cap) and hycY...pump (SANDCAT), plus SANDCAT tokens HgGb at $373k and E1eb at $156k with around $500k hourly volume each. Several other Felis copies already have near-zero liquidity, so they are dead or rugged.

authenticity.evidence: Only 54 unique sellers are behind 3,163 sells, against 2,088 buyers. GMGN tags 49 bundler wallets holding 20% of trader share. Turnover is 19 times market cap in 38 minutes. Liquidity is larger than market cap and was supplied by the deployer, with the LP unlocked. The coin was launched straight onto PumpSwap without a bonding curve. Its copies with the same setup (HNeJ, HFuU, 3tGd, BkNW) now have $0-$48 liquidity, which fits a repeated 'launch, farm volume, pull LP' pattern.
authenticity.uncertainty: The buyer count could include real retail drawn in by DexScreener trending. I could not see X posts or wallet funding sources directly.

structural_risks: The LP is 0% locked or burned and is controlled by the deployer, who can pull about $248k at any time
Several same-name copies built the same way have already had their liquidity drained
49 bundler wallets and very few unique sellers point to wash trading
Attention is split across more than 10 competing Felis/SANDCAT tokens

structured_output.counterargument: The theme is real and cute, and liquidity is deep for the market cap. Real retail buyers (about 2,000 of them) may be chasing it because it leads on volume. A deployer who put up $250k of liquidity might pump the price further before exiting, and doubling to about $335k market cap is small in absolute terms. The buy/sell ratio is strongly positive, and price is still climbing within the last 5 minutes.
unknowns: Who controls the LP, and when they plan to exit

source_coverage.notes: Searches for the contract address and ticker returned nothing. News turned up only general sand cat and cat-virality stories. DexScreener's web page returned 403, but its API worked. The project has no website; the 'website' field is just an X search link.

structured_output.thesis: The theme is real but the setup is poor: a non-canonical copy with deployer-owned, unlocked LP that is larger than market cap, and signs of wash trading (54 sellers, 49 bundlers). Its same-name siblings built this way have already been drained. The most likely outcome is an LP pull, not a double.
